title: Database Administrator (DBA)
description: Ensure high availability, replication, backup recovery, query performance tuning, and data security across enterprise database systems.

goal.objective: Guarantee the 24/7 availability, transaction integrity, disaster recovery, and query performance of critical enterprise databases.

learn.summary: Master PostgreSQL / MySQL internals, WAL logging, B-Tree and GIN indexes, streaming replication, connection poolers (PgBouncer), vacuuming, and point-in-time recovery (PITR).
key_competencies: PostgreSQL / MySQL Core Architecture & Storage Engines

capstone_projects.title: Zero-Data-Loss PostgreSQL High Availability Cluster with Patroni & etcd
capstone_projects.description: Deploy a resilient multi-node PostgreSQL HA cluster featuring DCS-backed automated failover via Patroni, connection pooling with pgBouncer, and split-brain defenses.

capstone_projects.title: Zero-Downtime Database Migration & Change Data Capture Pipeline
capstone_projects.description: Execute a zero-downtime database sharding and migration pipeline streaming WAL changes via Debezium CDC into an analytical data store with schema validation.

interview_focus: ACID Properties & Transaction Isolation Levels (Read Committed to Serializable Anomalies)
PostgreSQL MVCC, VACUUM Mechanics, Table Bloat & Write Amplification
B-Tree vs Hash vs GIN vs GiST Indexing Strategies & EXPLAIN ANALYZE Execution Plans
Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR), WAL Archiving & Backup Verification Automation
Distributed Consensus (etcd / Raft) in Database Failover & Quorum Management

tree.name: Essential IT Foundations for DBAs
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable systems administration foundation for database operations: master Linux kernel I/O scheduling, storage block devices, networking, and virtualization.

resources.title: Networking Fundamentals - CompTIA Network+ N10-008 - Full Course

children.name: Linux OS Administration for Databases
children.description: Master enterprise Linux administration for database hosts: file systems (XFS, ext4 mount options `noatime`), process scheduling, memory management, user access control (`sudo`, PAM), and systemd service unit management.

children.name: Linux System Utilities & Scripting
children.description: Automate administrative DBA workflows with Bash and Python: writing automated backup scripts, log rotation, health check probes, and parsing system diagnostic commands.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Networking Fundamentals & Security
children.description: Master database networking and perimeter security: TCP/IP socket tuning (`net.core.somaxconn`), firewall configuration (`iptables`/`firewalld`), SSH bastion tunneling, and configuring TLS/SSL encryption for client-server database connections.

resources.title: Networking Basics for Beginners - An Introduction to Computer Networks (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Server Hardware, Storage & Virtualization
children.description: Understand storage hardware performance: NVMe SSDs, RAID levels (RAID 10 for database write throughput vs RAID 5 write penalties), I/O schedulers (`none`/`mq-deadline`), and storage area networks (SAN/NAS).

resources.title: Build an Online Store Using AWS, React, and Stripe
Choosing Storage Modes for Composite Models in Power BI: Import, Dual, or DirectQuery?

children.name: Virtualization & Containerization Basics
children.description: Operate containerized and virtualized databases: VMware ESXi, KVM, Docker volumes for persistent storage, and evaluating database performance penalties in containerized environments.

resources.title: Docker Crash Course for Absolute Beginners

tree.name: Relational Database Fundamentals
tree.description: Master relational database internals: storage engine mechanics, transaction logging, concurrency control, and advanced SQL query execution.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Database Architecture & Internals
children.description: Deep dive into RDBMS engine architecture: client connection processes, memory architecture (shared memory buffer pool, process private memory), background writer processes, checkpointer, and Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mechanics.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners
Database Internals: How Database Stores Data? (Buffer Pool, WAL, LSM Trees, B Trees & More)

children.name: ACID, Transactions & Concurrency Control
children.description: Master transaction isolation and concurrency control: ACID properties, ANSI SQL isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable), anomalies (dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, phantom reads, write skew), and table/row-level lock contention and deadlock detection.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners

children.name: SQL Mastery & Advanced Querying (PostgreSQL)
children.description: Master PostgreSQL SQL dialactics: CTEs, window functions, JSONB operations (`->`, `->>`, `@>`), arrays, generating test data with `generate_series()`, and procedural programming with PL/pgSQL.

resources.title: SQL Window Function | How to write SQL Query using RANK, DENSE RANK, LEAD/LAG

children.name: Schema Design, Data Modeling & Constraints
children.description: Design production relational schemas: normalization (1NF through 3NF/BCNF), surrogate vs natural primary keys, foreign key constraints, check constraints, table partitioning (declarative range, list, and hash partitioning), and data type selection.

resources.title: Database Design Course - Learn how to design and plan a database for beginners
SQL Window Function | How to write SQL Query using RANK, DENSE RANK, LEAD/LAG

children.name: Indexing Strategies & Maintenance
children.description: Master database indexing mechanics: B-Tree internal node and leaf page structure, GIN (Generalized Inverted Index) for JSONB and full-text search, GiST for geometric data, BRIN (Block Range Index) for massive timeseries tables saving 99% disk space, partial indexes, and covering indexes with `INCLUDE`.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners
SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners

children.name: PostgreSQL Configuration & Management
children.description: Master PostgreSQL internals: Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC), heap tuple visibility, transaction ID (XID) wraparound risks, and tuning the Autovacuum daemon (`autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor`, `autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit`, `vacuum_freeze_min_age`).

resources.title: Learn PostgreSQL Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners

tree.name: Database Operations & Reliability Engineering
tree.description: Ensure enterprise database high availability, zero data loss, disaster recovery, and automated maintenance.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Book - Data Intensive Applications

children.name: Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery Strategies
children.description: Master enterprise backup and Disaster Recovery: physical backups with pgBackRest or WAL-G (full, differential, and incremental backups), WAL archiving, Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR) to exact transaction timestamps, and automating logical backups with `pg_dump`.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Backup and Restore (pg_dump, pg_basebackup, PITR)
PostgreSQL Point in Time Recovery (PITR) with WAL Archiving

children.name: Replication, High Availability (HA) & Load Balancing
children.description: Architect High Availability (HA) clusters: PostgreSQL physical streaming replication (synchronous vs asynchronous, replication slots), logical replication, automatic failover orchestration with Patroni and etcd/Consul, and connection pooling with PgBouncer.

resources.title: PostgreSQL High Availability, Load Balancing, and Replication
Patroni: A Template for PostgreSQL High Availability
High Availability PostgreSQL with Patroni – Full Setup Tutorial (Techno Tim)
Patroni PostgreSQL Tutorial - Automatic Failover for PostgreSQL

children.name: Database Monitoring, Logging & Alerting
children.description: Implement comprehensive database observability: tracking cache hit ratios, transaction throughput, replication lag in bytes/seconds, connection saturation, and deadlocks using `pg_stat_statements`, Prometheus `postgres_exporter`, and Grafana dashboards.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]

children.name: Database Patching & Version Upgrades
children.description: Execute zero-downtime database upgrades: minor version in-place binary upgrades, major version upgrades with `pg_upgrade --link` (hard links), and zero-downtime major version migrations using logical replication.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Full Upgrade with pg_upgrade - Major Version Database Upgrade

children.name: Automation for DBAs & Infrastructure as Code
children.description: Automate database infrastructure: provisioning database instances using Terraform and configuring database clusters idempotently with Ansible playbooks.

resources.title: Python for DevOps: Automating DB Tasks
Terraform Course - From BEGINNER to PRO! (Learn Terraform with Examples)
Learn Terraform with Google Cloud Platform – Infrastructure as Code Course

children.name: Capacity Planning, Scaling & Partitioning
children.description: Plan capacity and scale database workloads: forecasting disk growth, connection pooling sizing formulas, vertical scaling thresholds, and horizontal read scaling with read replicas.

resources.title: Database Sharding - System Design Interview Concept

children.name: Practice Lab: Operational Drill
children.description: Hands-on DBA Lab: build a multi-node PostgreSQL replication cluster, simulate primary node crash, execute automated Patroni failover, and perform point-in-time disaster recovery.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Physical Streaming Replication on AWS EC2 - Failover Test
MySQL Backup and Recovery Tutorial | Point-in-Time Recovery with Binary Log

tree.name: Database Performance & Security Optimization
tree.description: Optimize query execution, tune operating system parameters, enforce role-based security, and ensure regulatory compliance.

resources.title: SQL Performance Tuning Tutorial For Beginners | Learn SQL Performance Tuning For Free
Database Security Tutorial | Learn Database Security in 1 Hour

children.name: Query Performance Tuning & Optimization
children.description: Tune slow queries systematically: analyzing `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, VERBOSE)` query plans, identifying sequential scans on large tables, eliminating expensive nested loops, resolving Cartesian products, and utilizing `pg_stat_statements` to target top query resource consumers.

resources.title: SQL Query Optimization and performance tuning tips | SQL Tutorial for Beginners | SQL Interview tips

children.name: Database Server & OS-Level Tuning
children.description: Tune operating system and database server parameters: calculating optimal PostgreSQL memory settings (`shared_buffers`, `work_mem`, `maintenance_work_mem`, `effective_cache_size`), tuning Linux kernel virtual memory (`vm.swappiness=1`, `vm.overcommit_memory=2`), and enabling Transparent HugePages.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Performance Tuning: Top 5 Parameters (Must Watch)
Linux Kernel Tuning for Database Performance

children.name: Database Security, Access Control & Authentication
children.description: Implement enterprise database security: role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege role hierarchies, `pg_hba.conf` client authentication configuration (SCRAM-SHA-256, certificate authentication), and Row-Level Security (RLS) policies.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course
SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners

children.name: Data Encryption, Masking & Compliance
children.description: Implement complete data encryption: encryption in transit (enforcing TLS 1.3), encryption at rest (Linux LUKS or transparent database encryption), column-level cryptographic hashing with `pgcrypto`, and complying with PCI-DSS / HIPAA standards.

resources.title: Data Protection Rules for Businesses and Organisations — European Commission

children.name: Auditing, Vulnerability Management & Security Patching
children.description: Audit database operations: deploying `pgaudit` for detailed session and DDL/DML audit logging, database vulnerability scanning, and monitoring failed connection attempts.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Web Application Security

tree.name: Cloud Databases & Advanced Incident Management
tree.description: Manage cloud databases, execute cross-region migrations, and lead incident postmortems.

children.name: Managed Database Services Deep Dive
children.description: Master cloud managed database offerings: AWS RDS PostgreSQL, AWS Aurora PostgreSQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, and Google Cloud SQL; understanding shared responsibility limits and parameter group management.

children.name: Cloud Database Operations, Cost Optimization & IaC
children.description: Optimize cloud database spend: rightsizing compute instances, evaluating Provisioned IOPS (io2) vs baseline storage, and automated snapshot lifecycle management.

children.name: Database Migration Strategies to/from Cloud
children.description: Execute database cloud migrations: homogenous and heterogeneous database migrations with minimal downtime using AWS DMS, Azure DMS, or native logical replication pipelines.

children.name: Incident Management, Runbooks & Post-Mortems
children.description: Lead database incident response: resolving database replication lag spikes, mitigating connection pool exhaustion, recovering from disk full emergency states, and authoring blameless post-incident reviews.

resources.title: Postmortem Culture: Learning from Failure — Google SRE

children.name: Project: Advanced Cloud Database Operations Lab
children.description: Hands-on Cloud Lab: deploy a multi-region PostgreSQL cluster on cloud infrastructure with automated cross-region backup replication and benchmark failover times.

tree.name: Specialized & Emerging Database Technologies
tree.description: Master NoSQL systems, distributed SQL architectures, timeseries databases, and polyglot persistence strategies.

children.name: NoSQL Databases Deep Dive
children.description: Operate NoSQL database clusters: MongoDB (sharding, replica sets, wiredTiger cache), Apache Cassandra (wide-column partition keys, compaction strategies, read/write consistency levels), and Redis cluster operations.

children.name: Data Warehousing, Data Lakes & ETL/ELT
children.description: Manage analytical data warehouses: columnar architectures, ETL/ELT batch load tuning, and maintaining warehouse storage efficiency.

resources.title: What Is a Data Warehouse? — Oracle

children.name: Search, Graph & Time-Series Databases
children.description: Operate specialized database engines: TimescaleDB / InfluxDB for high-throughput timeseries telemetry, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch for full-text search clusters, and Neo4j for connected graph relationships.

children.name: Distributed SQL Databases
children.description: Master NewSQL and Distributed SQL engines: CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, and Google Cloud Spanner; understanding distributed transactions, Raft consensus per range/tablet, and multi-region data placement.

children.name: Polyglot Persistence & Data Strategy
children.description: Formulate enterprise polyglot persistence strategies: matching distinct application workload requirements to appropriate database paradigms (relational, document, key-value, graph, search, distributed SQL) while minimizing operational complexity.
